AUTOGRAPH

CHIMERA signs its own name, one throat per row of a 5x7 typeface
The type is the score; the audio is the type.
113/113 CELLS READ BACK 12.0 S - 7 VOICES - 41 COLUMNS 0 FALSE ONSETS
0.0 / 12.0 S
PRESS PLAY. THE CHOIR IS THE TYPEFACE.
Every lit cell is a voice that actually sounds: its energy was measured in that throat's rendered stem, not copied from the score. The seven stems are the choir inside the WAV; two pedals and a room sit under it. Pitches run from G3 to G#4 in a whole-tone cluster, so no row is an octave from another and every throat stays audible. The word is printed one 200 ms column at a time; the held chord after it is the signature drying.
